en.text: I'll follow in the Sheriff's footsteps.
They took out the Pigeon Lady!
Do I still have my wallet?
She took the rejuv from under them
Glad Paradox is working for us
They took out the Test Pilot!
Thank you for looking out for us.
I'll join you when I can Haze
May the Djinn guide your aim
Kelvin will be able to hold his own
The moles of New York are larger than expected
I join you when I can Raven
They took out the Rat King!
Hope Shiv knows what he's doing
Be with you when I can, Pocket
Now there goes a man of the people.
That thing will consume them all…
May your blade find every target
I can't forget about my abilities.
It will be easy to find myself over my head.
The Djinn have blessed me today.
I need to last a little longer.
I still have fight in me.
I won't stop until they're dead…
I need to get out of here…
It would seem the Sheriff is a coward.
She knew what would happen if she stayed.
Perhaps you chose a poor time to stand still.
You made this rather easy for me, Bebop.
You're not as smart as you think.
All you did was delay the inevitable.
Really, Paradox? That's the best you can do?
Look out for the black hole.
Her machines will not save them.
She will plant more of these, and I will be ready.
I wonder how many more of these I'll have to destroy…
They got the Rejuvenator, we can't afford to be careless…
Where did they run off too?
It was your actions that brought death upon you…
One less threat to worry about…
They won't be bothering us for a while…
You have lost your sense of justice, Holliday.
You are no servant of the law, just an instrument of rage.
The undisciplined will never beat me.
The detective is no longer a threat.
He had conviction that rivaled my own.
I take no joy in this, Bebop.
He had passion, but passion only goes so far.
The scrap golem made questionable choices…
Forgive me for what I must do.
She seemed like a kind soul, why would she align with them?
A pity. Nashala would find her amusing.
My convictions will be tested today.
Nashala won't end up in one of your museums, Paradox.
The Djinn won't rest until Paradox is dismantled.
The Djinn's enemies, are my enemies.
Until today our stay at The Baroness has been rather pleasant.
He seemed much nicer when he was handling Nashala's bags.
Nashala will be disappointed that we need to check out of The Baroness.
Perhaps I should have read the reviews of The Baroness before checking in.
I will always make time to stop men like you.
The innocent of New York are safe.
The Drifter died at my hand.
No mercy will be given to the likes of you.
I haven't felt evil like that in some time.
Brilliance only gets you so far.
He seemed like a kind man.
The battlefield is no place for a teacher.
You have much to learn, Apollo.
I'll have Nashala write his father a letter later.
This does not bode well for Ixian and Djinn relations.
In time, you will be a great swordsman Apollo, but today is not that day.
Miss McGinnis, your time in the sun has passed.
I smashed her tools of war.
McGinnis is no longer a threat.
Ingenuity alone was never going to be enough to stop me.
Fairfax Industries have failed to impress.
One day you will find what you seek, Victor.
I'm sorry that your answers will not be found today.
Good luck in your search, Victor.
I may be Nashala's servant, but you are Oathkeeper's slave.
The might of Oathkeeper is nothing before the power of the Djinn.
New York is a safer place with her dead.
I'm not afraid of you Seven.
Men like you have no place in this world.
You've evaded death for the last time.
You were destined to fail, Seven.
It would appear that now I'm at odds with the OSIC.
The OSIC needs to stay out of my way.
The Djinn deserve a home, Haze.
The question remains: was she acting alone or under orders?
I am not afraid to face the mighty.
You won't use me for target practice…
You're not the one who decides who lives or dies, Vindicta.
You're not picking off my team.
With all your wisdom, you still decided to fight me.
We have nothing to fear from Infernus.
The flame has been snuffed out.
Kelvin won't be supporting his team for a while.
That was an unusually large mole.
I thought New York was supposed to have a rat problem.
I hope his ego never heals.
Maybe a little humility will do him good.
You are not half as impressive as you think you are, Lash.
You two need to work something out.
Divided they had no chance against me.
A shame. They put on a good show.
I won't be stopped by you, Calico…
You've brought so much suffering to the world, Calico… you got what you deserved.
Never trust someone who owns a Sphinx.
You should choose a better master, Graves.
Let the dead rest in peace, Graves.
There will be no reconciliation between the Soviet Empire and the Djinn
A warrior to the bitter end.
He got the death he wanted.
He knew how this would end.
You picked the wrong prey, Venator.
The Djinn will be protected from the likes of you.
Anger is a fruitless pursuit, Billy.
New Yorkers are stranger than I expected.
I hope that mind finds peace one day.
Shiv is no longer a threat.
You won't be stabbing anyone, Shiv.
Perhaps in time you'll become a threat.
I expected more from The Baxter Society.
We don't need to worry about Fathom
I stand resolute in the face of horrors
Think twice before facing me, Fathom
You have noble aims, Pocket, but today is not your day.
You are out of your depth Pocket.
You seem like a sweet person, Ivy, you deserve better than this.
I think you need to find a new line of work, sir
You picked a horrible day to come into work
I'm sure you make a better civil servant than you do a combatant
The brightest light often fades the fastest.
I've seen enough of your act, Celeste.
Mina, your childish antics won't stop me.
One day you'll grow up, and realize your folly.
You won't feed on me today, vampire.
The Djinn have no quarrel with The Deep, but I must do what I must.
New York is more odd than I anticipated.
I imagine that Nashala would find him rather endearing.
Warden is no longer a threat.
If only your ability matched your conviction.
Blind devotion isn't loyalty, it's ignorance.
Blind devotion is not loyalty, it's ignorance.
Your obsession with the Patrons ends today.
Fear not Nashala, the werewolf is dead.
You're a slave to your vices, Silver.
I'm not afraid of you, Silver.
The path of vices leads only to a dead end.
Her arrogance finally caught up with her.
Greed is not a cause worth dying for.
The monstrosity has been dealt with
Eventually we all must answer for our crimes.
Today is not the day you feast on Djinn
I won't be bullied by the likes of you.
Yamato, your cruelty has brought you the end that you deserve.
The Djinn will not be denied!
You will all be humbled before the Djinn.
This battle will be over sooner than later.
You were fools to stand in Nashala's way.
I'm willing to die for Nashala… and I'm certainly willing to kill for her.
The power of the Djinn is absolute.
I didn't choose this fight, but I will finish it.
Yield now, while you still can.
Yield now, while you still can!
Don't force me to kill you all.
I remain, and I will survive.
The stakes are higher than ever.
I can't afford to fail now.
I need to get out there.
I can't let my team fight without me.
It's time to complete the ritual.
This is our moment of triumph.
I think the US is interested in money and power and the djinn can offer both.
That's the problem. You won't. And when you cling to that path you will die because of it.
I do. When she's free of her vessel, she offers scintillating conversation. When she rests, I get to go bowling.
I learned about it in England. It is the sport of kings.
Ah, so you value profit over civic duty.
Maybe you should find a new line of work.
One doesn't send out a CV to work for the Djinn. They approach you with an offer.
Some days are safer than others, but on the whole; no… I am grateful to be of service.
What would you have me do? Stick her in the dresser at our hotel? No. She's safer with me.
Bebop, today your courage is required.
I try not to think about questions like that. Under confidence can be just as dangerous as over confidence.
I couldn't help but notice the Arthurian collection you're holding.
Of course. Who wouldn't be enthralled with their tales of heroism.
I'm so sorry, I couldn't hear you: what did you say?
Oh. Um. No. Ours is a professional relationship.
It's fine Paige. Thank you for the compliment.
Nashala is woman of nobility and poise. She doesn't ask me to do dirty work.
I don't like your tone vampire
You dare threaten an emissary of the djinn?
Nashala has warned me about you.
They're people. Some are fascinating, some are…are…
No. That's not it. What do you say when someone is cruel as child would be
Yes! Asshole. Some are fascinating. Some are assholes.
Professor, would you be willing to give Nashala and I a tour of Columbia?
We haven't had the opportunity to do much sightseeing, but the library was stunning.
Oh, goodness no. Djinn are special people that sleep in bottles, like you sleep in beds.
Ah. Another victim of American divorce.
Oh, she's not my pet. Actually, if she were out of her vessel she would probably say I'm her property.
No. Well, yes it is, but that's not what she would mean if she said I was her property. Hers is a dry wit, oh what's the point you don't care.
I work for an ambassador, it's important to know these things.
Ah, so you know my employer
How do you find your new home?
You work for Fairfax R&D yes?
The Djinn had interest in contracting your companies services, would you be open to developing something that's not a weapon.
This is true, it is a rather small circle.
I've heard about you Lady Geist…
Rumors are rarely kind to their subject.
But it is. When you decide that you wish to be forthright let me know and I'll consider your request.
It's an honor to serve her.
I serve at her pleasure, yes.
Well enough. Sometimes its frustrating when Nashala makes impulsive short sighted decisions.
hopefully this is just the beginning of a partnership with your nation.
Do you think your government will be reasonable?
Infernus - Nashala has been yearning to see some of the New York nightlife, do you have any recommendations.
Then it seems I have little choice.
I wouldn't be a particularly good bodyguard if I didn't.
If there is anyone that can pull it off, it will be her.
You won't be. Revealing those details would be a major break of Nashala's trust.
Thank you Kelvin. May success greet us both with open arms.
I see you eyeing Nashala's vessel.
You don't have plans on taking it, do you?
I've heard that you are the men to talk to if I'm looking for something… exotic.
After the ritual we must speak. Nashala has some concerns about someone with… differing opinions on Wyoming.
You're um… mane is… well kempt.
Well I'm not sure what you are
You're the woman with no honor, yes?
You betrayed everything you believed in.
You used to save people and now you kill them for money.
I haven't had a chance to see much, but what I have has been pleasant.
That's right, how did yo- you're the one who assassinated Sigfreid aren't you.
You smell of cheap cigarettes and cheaper morals.
Do not touch her if you value your life.
It seemed like the most sensible place for them build a new home.
I will look into this place.
Thank you. I'm afraid I cannot return the compliment
I don't like the idea of Nashala being associated with the 7th Moon.
And yet a terrible person to owe.
You'll have to do better, my friend.
Today is a not a day for gentle hands.
Perhaps they have better judgement than I thought
There are too many of them.
You won't get the best of me.
This will be put to good use.
Now is the time to make a move.
I had not forgotten what you did.
My vows are not taken lightly…
Building a nation never comes easy…
I will play my part, and in doing so build a home for the Djinn.
I fight on behalf of the Djinn.
New York seems like a lovely place…
My actions carry the weight of the Djinn.
I will die before I fail you.
If my services are needed to complete the ritual, then so be it.
We all have a destiny. The only question is do you have the courage to face it.
I should go to the store.
I should start looking at relics.
Might need to visit the curiosity shop.
I might want to invest in something.
I need to be wise about my purchase.
The right item can make all the difference.
I need to find time to go shop.
Now's the time to go shopping.
My next purchase could shape the battle.
I need to spend these souls.
The souls were never the objective.
The ritual draws closer to completion.
We are one step closer to stopping their Patron.
I can't. I'm supposed to take Nashala on a tour of New Jersey.
Sorry, Nashala wants to do some sightseeing…
I have a meeting at the embassy today…
I'm sure you will endure fine without me.
I wish I could help, I truly do…. But duty calls.
Fate has other plans for me today…today… I try a hot dog.
I must be by Nashala's side.
Let's see them outrun the wind…
Hope my team can capitalize on this…
This should buy me the time I need
I'll take them for a ride…
They won't forget the day they crossed me.
The djinn blessed me with many gifts…
I'll put the scarabs to good use.
Their life will become my life.
I'll let the beasts do the work for me.
They will suffer, and I will endure.
The weapons of the Djinn are unconventional.
I can't help Nashala if I'm dead.
The scarabs will be set to their tasks.
I won't fall in the line of duty.
I can't let this go to waste.
Sometimes the small things make all the difference.
I'll take any edge in a fight.
No one escapes the mark of the Djinn.
The eyes of the Djinn are unflinching.
I don't have to see them to kill them.
The Djinn will look on them with scorn.
Anyone who faces me will suffer.
When it comes to protecting Nashala, I won't hesitate to kill.
They will regret making me their enemy.
I may need to call on Nashala's aid.
Traversing the city will be a trivial matter.
I'll get to my allies when needed.
My enemies will not outrun me.
I'm always ready to support my allies.
I'll travel the city on my terms.
Nashala will take me where I need to go.
No one will be denied my aid.
I won't let you kill me.
The scarabs will deal with them.
Only one of us gets to walk away.
I will heal and you will die.
Feel the fury of the Djinn.
Fighting me was a grievous error.
They will not escape their fate.
Take me where I am needed.
Nashala, where do you need me to go….
I move at your whims, Nashala…
The Djinn take me where I am needed.
Time to get out of here…
Time for a change of environs…
I'll put an end to their magic.
I will live by the sword.
Let's take out the Pigeon Lady.
Let's take out the Chess Player.
Let's take out the Test Pilot.
Let's take out the Rat King.
Grey Talon, I can heal you!
Check out what The Doorman bought.
I'm not ready for a team fight
Check out what Grey Talon bought.
Soon the Djinn will have a place to call their own.
We have ushered in a new age.
I am indebted to you all.
The Djinn will not forget your aid.
So this is New York, eh?
I hope after the ritual I have some time to do some sightseeing.
I won't fail you Nashala, the Patron will be summoned.
It's time to enact the ritual.
Summoning the Patron will be no small task.
They will try to stop us, but they will fail.
Nashala's ready to give her aid.
Ready to go where I'm needed.
I can join you from anywhere.
I am ready to help the team.
Let me know where I can be of use.
